reviews.review:
Warhammer 40k: Space Marine is an absolutely rocksolid game. Not less, but also not really more than that. The campaign is pretty short and very straightforward. The most important thing in these kind of games is the gameplay and it is mixed bag. It definitely is not bad, but it does have a few hickups. The main thing, that I did not like was the mobility or rather the lack there of. You play as the titular Space Marine and those are obviously very big and clad in massive armor. So it makes sense that every step they take is very weighted, but I found myself often going around at a slower speed than I would have liked to, because the sprinting is pretty hard to control. Mobility also was an issue for while in combat, because there is no way to quickly exit combat when your health is down. So once you're caught up in melee combat you either kill all your opponents or you die. That led to the very few frustrating moments I had with this game. Another thing I did not like was the constant shaking while in combat. Every time a grenade goes of or a rocket explodes or you do special attacks, the screen shakes a lot which makes it harder to control the battle. The rest of the gameplay is somewhat basic shooter gameplay, with a variety of different weaponry. It is fun, it is solid, but nothing special, just like the whole game. But the game is able to rack up a few extra parts in other categories, mainly visually. It is very much a Warhammer 40k game, which translates very well into the visuals. Everything is enormous and absolutely massive, which leads to at times brilliant views and scenes. For a game form 2011 it looks more than decent. The story again is nothing special. It does have potential for more, but it is solid. 

Pros:
+ general gameplay is solid
+ visuals and lore are very much Warhammer 40k, which makes it stand out 

Cons:
- lack of mobility and a lot of shaking during combat
- story could have had a bit more depth and could have been longer

Generally a game that is enjoyable for the 7-10 hours you will be playing it.

6/10 points
